defect: verify-vendor's corpus walk counted bytecode caches as corpus content
reported_by: t16 / Deep Worker (finding F1), reproduced and fixed at the root by the captain
symptom: `python3 -m py_compile <helper>` (a documented verify command) writes skills/ast-grep/scripts/__pycache__/*.pyc; the corpus then reads 298 files and the gate fails with 'asset skills count drifted: 298 vs 297'. The .pyc was not gitignored, so it could also have been committed as corpus content.

fix.scripts/verify-vendor.mjs: listFiles() now skips `__pycache__` directories and `*.pyc` / `*.pyo` files, the same way it already skipped `node_modules`
fix.pin_impact: none - the current corpus contains no bytecode, so the computed fileCount/treeSha are unchanged

measurement.method: isolated git worktree at the wave's HEAD revision, one bytecode file placed under skills/ast-grep/scripts/__pycache__/
